title: Best and worst close per ticker
statementMd:
For each symbol show its lowest and highest closing price.

Expected columns: `symbol`, `low_close`, `high_close`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT symbol, MIN(close) AS low_close, MAX(close) AS high_close FROM prices GROUP BY symbol;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
